title: "reset the rendering context to its default state" should also clear the "current default path"

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Ideal for someone new to a WHATWG standard or software project

labels.name: compat
labels.description: Standard is not web compatible or proprietary feature needs standardizing

body:
Related to  https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5618#issuecomment-664109716.

When a canvas element with a 2D context has either its `width` or `height` being changed, [current texts][1] ask that the ["set bitmap dimensions"][2] algorithm is executed, itself calling ["reset the rendering context to its default state"](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#reset-the-rendering-context-to-its-default-state).

> When the user agent is to **reset the rendering context to its default state**, it must clear the drawing state stack and everything that [drawing state][4] consists of to initial values.

In the ["drawing state"][4] definition there is a note specifying clearly

> The [current default path][5] and the rendering context's bitmaps are not part of the drawing state. The [current default path][5] is persistent, and can only be reset using the [`beginPath()`][6] method. The bitmaps depend on whether and how the rendering context is bound to a [`canvas`][7] element.

The "context's bitmap" is cleared in the second step of ["set bitmap dimensions"][2], but the "current default path" is never explicitly reset in this algorithm.  
This means that according to these texts the "current default path" should not be cleared when the canvas dimension is set again.

However [all implementations do reset it][8], I think they always did, and I'm sure a lot of websites are expecting it to happen.

So I believe a new step in this "reset the rendering context to its default state" algorithm should be included to specifically reset the "current default path".


[1]: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#the-canvas-element:concept-canvas-set-bitmap-dimensions
[2]: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#concept-canvas-set-bitmap-dimensions
[3]: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#reset-the-rendering-context-to-its-default-state
[4]: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#drawing-state
[5]: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#current-default-path
[6]: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#dom-context-2d-beginpath
[7]: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#the-canvas-element
[8]: https://jsfiddle.net/ywbmt3eu/
